slides.title: Research first
slides.body: Check the role's range on job portals and with seniors before the interview.

slides.title: Give a range, not one number
slides.body: Keep your target near the lower-middle of your range.

slides.title: Show flexibility
slides.body: "Based on my research, around X to Y. I'm open to discussing it for the right role."

slides.title: Never say "anything is fine"
slides.body: It sounds like you don't value your skills.
